summary.text: Jordan Wheatley is the Democratic nominee for the Texas House of Representatives, District 67, having defeated Emeka Eluka in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
Ballotpedia also lists him as a withdrawn candidate in the 2026 Democratic primary for U.S. House Texas District 3.
